FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 304
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 304 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Corrections,
by an estimated $85 per day, to house certain mandatory release defendants for violations of
mandatory supervision, and reduce the obligations of the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles, by an
estimated $3.30 per day per defendant that is no longer under the supervision of the Bureau,
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
